snippet.title: Digital Processing - Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
A short narrative-driven incremental management game in a mysterious office workplace.

Welcome to Halcyon Dynamics! In your new role you'll be expected to process digits efficiently and build a small well-motivated team, if you have the right attitude. It is Rewarding and Prestigious work, you don't want to collect your severance package.

Wishlist on Steam now!
